provides.port: kernel twin (TypeScript model of mandates and effects)

owns: workspaces, principals and sign-in (schemas app, auth)
mandates, decisions, tasks, runs and their steps
effects and their receipts, the hash-chained ledger
documents and their versions, knowledge, memory, routines, channel threads
piece registrations: each module's or surface's declared capabilities and digest
data.export: not built: an export of the ledger as JSONL and the data as a SQL dump is planned

exemptions.reason: pnpm check runs the core's own tests; the promise tests run apart (pnpm oracle), and scenes and lifecycle are not implemented for this core
no export command yet; the data lives in one PostgreSQL cluster
the core keeps its own database passwords beside the cluster (an owner-only file) and run secrets; it hands no secret value to another piece or a model
listed as core responsibilities, not built in this schema yet; the platform's credential store stands in for sealed secrets

removal.rule: not removable: every other piece stands on it; it is replaced whole by a core that passes the promise tests, once its UNKNOWN effects are settled

swap: another core behind the same crossings, judged by the promise tests in oracle/ through an adapter in oracle/adapters/
